Codex review: needs maintainer review before merge. ## What this changes This PR closes idle warm CLI sessions under memory pressure and refuses new sessions with an actionable memory-specific message when necessary. **Example:** A fifth Claude CLI conversation starts with four warm processes and 424 MiB available. - **Before:** Another process starts despite the host's low memory. - **After:** An idle process closes, available memory rises to 1124 MiB in the supplied trace, and the new conversation replies. ## Review scores | Measure | Result | What it means | |---|---|---| | **Overall readiness** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | A focused fix with relevant Gateway evidence and distinct regression coverage; the live memory-pressure scenario uses simulated readings rather than actual Linux exhaustion. | | **Proof confidence** | 🐚 platinum hermit **(4/6)** | Sufficient (logs): Supplied isolated-Gateway traces exercise real Claude processes through openclaw agent under simulated memory readings, covering idle eviction, successful reuse, and all-busy refusal; later production changes preserve the diagnosis through regression-tested reply rendering, and the latest head changes only tests. | | **Patch quality** | 🦞 diamond lobster **(5/6)** | No actionable review findings were identified. | ## Product **Kind:** Bug fix · **Worth it:** Yes · **Fix scope:** Complete **User problem:** Several Claude CLI conversations can exhaust host memory and leave the Gateway unable to make useful progress. **Reason:** The reported operational failure warrants a bounded admission safeguard, and collaborator authorship establishes direction for the documented resource tradeoff. ## Merge readiness ✅ **Ready for maintainer review** This PR addresses a concrete host-memory failure that current main still permits; the earlier reply-copy finding is fixed, and no introduced correctness defect was found. **Priority:** P1 **Reviewed head:** `29d424bdc3bdc497feaa6c0e72b87947d1a8229c` ## Before merge None. ## Findings None.
Agent review details ### How this fits together The Gateway's plugin execution host delegates warm-process ownership to the live-session registry, which now checks host memory before admitting another process and sends refusal facts through the shared failover renderer. ```mermaid flowchart TD A[Conversation turn] --> B[Plugin execution host] B --> C[Live session registry] C --> D[Host memory reading] C --> E[Close idle process and await exit] C --> F[Claude CLI process] C --> G[Failover reply renderer] ``` ### Technical review Best possible solution: Land the focused registry-owned admission check and shared failure copy after the existing CI gate passes. Do we have a high-confidence way to reproduce the issue? Current main limits warm sessions by count alone, allowing additional processes despite low host memory; the incident report and supplied Gateway trace substantiate that path without a reviewer-run reproduction. Is this the best way to solve the issue? The change uses the existing capacity, cleanup, and reply-copy owners, preserves busy sessions and compatible reuse, and adds two regressions for distinct eviction and refusal failures. AGENTS.md: found and applied where relevant. Codex review notes: model internal, reasoning medium; reviewed against [ff8fe07318eb](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/ff8fe07318eb597ceb8178a81b218c8884695410). ### Provenance checked - `Warm-session capacity and eviction` changes intended behavior with a stated reason (12d0fd2ef8afa92c5c9480de0f090e34488d565e: Keep compatible CLI processes warm under one host-owned registry with a fixed capacity bound.) - `Process retirement and cleanup` keeps the original intent (bcef3b3526dd1d015e0b1c1030a1dea12cf1b517: Do not release or replace owned work until its resource cleanup is confirmed.) - `Canonical failure copy and cooldown privacy` keeps the original intent (c0effea2ca1b42329a2eb8ce7e80553a71af4589: Keep saved-login diagnostics private while preserving useful recovery guidance through the shared renderer.) - `Structured CLI failure guidance` keeps the original intent (e60fbe9362af72cddeb03db3ace680080754d814: Preserve a specific CLI diagnostic as actionable user-facing copy rather than a generic failure.) ### Testing Proof path: shipped entry point. ### Security None. ### Evidence What I checked: - **Introduced patch and current main:** The pinned introduction adds memory admission, LRU ordering, and structured failure copy; the affected production files on fetched main retain the merge-base behavior without these changes. ([`src/agents/cli-runner/cli-live-session-registry.ts:196`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/29d424bdc3bdc497feaa6c0e72b87947d1a8229c/src/agents/cli-runner/cli-live-session-registry.ts#L196), [29d424bdc3bd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/29d424bdc3bdc497feaa6c0e72b87947d1a8229c)) - **Production-path proof:** The PR body supplies isolated-Gateway output through openclaw agent with real Claude processes and simulated host-memory readings: idle eviction restores headroom, compatible reuse performs no eviction, and all-busy refusal leaves the running turns able to complete. ([a646b6b806c9](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/a646b6b806c92239adda5da0d3566e2bda5bd62a)) - **Prior finding resolved:** The host-memory error code reaches both the shared code renderer and rate-limit reply renderer; the added execution-boundary regression checks the final reply summary. The latest commit changes only test setup and its allocation record. ([`src/agents/failover/user-copy.ts:411`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/29d424bdc3bdc497feaa6c0e72b87947d1a8229c/src/agents/failover/user-copy.ts#L411), [29d424bdc3bd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/29d424bdc3bdc497feaa6c0e72b87947d1a8229c)) - **Accepted availability tradeoff:** The collaborator-authored PR explicitly accepts cold starts after idle eviction and refusal below 1 GiB when no idle process can restore headroom; it also documents concurrent-start and container-memory limitations. ([`src/agents/cli-runner/cli-live-session-registry.ts:19`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/29d424bdc3bdc497feaa6c0e72b87947d1a8229c/src/agents/cli-runner/cli-live-session-registry.ts#L19), [29d424bdc3bd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/29d424bdc3bdc497feaa6c0e72b87947d1a8229c)) - **Existing lifecycle contract:** The registry introduced by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/128131 owns warm-process capacity; https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/139657 requires retained cleanup evidence. Memory eviction reuses closeRecord and waits for that cleanup rather than introducing another process owner. ([`src/agents/cli-runner/cli-live-session-registry.ts:127`](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/blob/bcef3b3526dd1d015e0b1c1030a1dea12cf1b517/src/agents/cli-runner/cli-live-session-registry.ts#L127), [bcef3b3526dd](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/bcef3b3526dd1d015e0b1c1030a1dea12cf1b517)) - **Related request remains distinct:** https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/161050 requests broader spawn and cron admission with cgroup pressure, queueing, and configurable policy; this PR narrowly protects warm CLI process admission and does not complete that request. ### PR surface Source +66, Tests +72, Other +2. Total +140 across 6 files. Added test files: 0.
View PR surface stats | Area | Files | Added | Removed | Net | |---|---:|---:|---:|---:| | Source | 4 | 73 | 7 | +66 | | Tests | 1 | 75 | 3 | +72 | | Docs | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Config | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Generated | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | | Other | 1 | 2 | 0 | +2 | | **Total** | **6** | **150** | **10** | **+140** |
### Labels Label changes: No label changes. Label justifications: - `P1`: The reported accumulation of warm Claude processes left a real Gateway host thrashing until reboot. - `merge-risk: 🚨 availability`: The new 1 GiB admission floor can refuse additional CLI conversations on constrained hosts; the collaborator-authored PR explicitly accepts this behavior to protect host availability. - `rating: 🐚 platinum hermit`: Overall readiness is 🐚 platinum hermit; proof is 🐚 platinum hermit and patch quality is 🦞 diamond lobster. - `status: 👀 ready for maintainer look`: ClawSweeper has no concrete contributor-facing blocker left for this PR. - `proof: sufficient`: Contributor real behavior proof is sufficient. ### Rating scale 6/6 🦀 challenger crab · 5/6 🦞 diamond lobster · 4/6 🐚 platinum hermit · 3/6 🦐 gold shrimp · 2/6 🦪 silver shellfish · 1/6 🧂 unranked krab. Overall follows the weaker of proof and patch quality; ✨ marks media proof (a screenshot, video, or linked artifact) that directly shows the changed behavior. ### Workflow ClawSweeper edits this one comment on every review. Comment `@clawsweeper re-review` for a fresh review only. Repair and merge execution lanes are retired. ### History
Review history (2 earlier review cycles) - reviewed 2026-11-04T04:43:15.064Z sha a646b6b806c92239adda5da0d3566e2bda5bd62a :: needs changes before merge. :: [P2] Preserve the host-memory diagnosis in channel replies - reviewed 2026-11-04T05:33:16.635Z sha fe0a5140ba62155cdbac198c475b4d3273f28be2 :: needs maintainer review before merge. :: none

Landed in de07e007d3b030b4b9a005edc963b53180b102b1.

- Bug: concurrent Claude CLI live sessions could exhaust host memory; the only limit was a fixed count of 16, so an 8 GB host thrashed for hours.
- Fix: before a new live session starts, free memory below 1 GiB closes idle sessions in least-recently-used order; if none are idle, the turn fails over with a host-memory error and its own reply copy. Busy sessions are never closed.
- Proof: entry-point tests that fail on main on behavior, plus an isolated Gateway run under simulated memory pressure.
